_sourcesComment: the real files this tour's real-app capture actually exercises (C2): the live affordance registry it resolves selectors from, the catalog data the roadmap listing/node detail in step_1/step_2 render, and the portal components that render the surfaces the tour drives (App.vue mounts the kit page; CatalogPanel.vue owns catalog-panel/lifecycle-pill-roadmap/object-listing/back-to-list) -- not a decoupled snapshot file (see docs/plan.md's C2 note on the affordances.json stand-in this replaced). demo-packet-gate.sh normalizes these external paths' mtimes (like it does the fixture dir) so freshness stays deterministic in CI.
